welcome_lead: Stretch — analyse the classical rhetorical devices used in great speeches.

final_note: You explored ethos, pathos and logos plus advanced devices like antithesis, epistrophe and asyndeton.

concepts.def: Contrast of opposites in balanced phrasing
Repetition at the END of clauses
Omission of conjunctions — 'I came, I saw.'

walkthroughs.body_html:
Ethos (character), pathos (emotion), logos (logic).

Great rhetoric balances all three.

'Ask not what your country can do for you — ask what you can do for your country.' — JFK.

Mirrored structure + opposing ideas = unforgettable.

Epistrophe: 'of the people, by the people, FOR THE PEOPLE'.

Asyndeton: 'I came, I saw, I conquered' — no 'ands' for breathless speed.
